platform.status: predictive research platform; not production-foundry evidence

hypotheses.hypothesis: The parity-bound C6 RTL can be remapped to ASAP7 without semantic modification.
hypotheses.bounded_change: technology mapping only; no RTL behavioral edits
hypotheses.predicted_information_gain: closes full-DP6 standard-cell logic area/timing feasibility or fail-closes on portability/tool semantics

hypotheses.hypothesis: RW5 and Argon logic can be technology-calibrated separately enough to identify the dominant standard-cell logic contributor.
hypotheses.bounded_change: separate synthesis views of existing generated modules only
hypotheses.predicted_information_gain: bounds RW5/Argon area and timing contribution without changing DP6

hypotheses.hypothesis: A 1.0 ns and 2.0 ns ASAP7 timing sensitivity can bound an attacker-favorable logic operating region.
hypotheses.bounded_change: clock constraint only within the same ASAP7 libraries
hypotheses.predicted_information_gain: bounds frequency/area/power tradeoff; no algorithm change

assumptions.power_activity: OpenROAD Liberty/statistical activity unless a valid VCD/SAIF is available; reported as estimate only
assumptions.memory: HBM4-class external state remains separate sensitivity model; not implemented as standard cells
assumptions.hbm4_model: RP-B3 inherited named HBM4-class model; no procurement price
